contract.scope: training-correlation behavioral confirmation, not organization-path mediation
contract.unit: world; all nested pairs equally weighted within each world
contract.test: two-sided one-sample t on eight world-level paired differences, df=7
contract.assumption: independent generated worlds; approximately normal world-level differences
contract.multiplicity: Holm across the three confirmatory endpoints, family alpha=0.05
contract.sensitivity: all 256 world sign flips; valid under null sign symmetry, not an unconditional randomized-treatment test
contract.zero_sd: all-zero differences: t=0,p=1,CI=[0,0], degenerate/no equivalence; constant nonzero differences: t/p/CI=null, Holm input=1, adjusted p=1
contract.stopping: fixed eight worlds; no interim outcome inspection or optional extension
contract.publication: all three endpoints, signs, all E/U/global-D/base checks published regardless of significance; no automatic natural-language or editor-method trigger
